decision: Do not form a US entity until a buyer, investor or AWS Marketplace listing needs one. Two new facts change the calculus. AWS Marketplace now accepts India-based sellers, but they can sell only to buyers in India, so global AWS Marketplace sales need a non-India entity (Microsoft Marketplace showed no such restriction). And an Indian resident who owns a Delaware company is making an Overseas Direct Investment under FEMA/RBI OI Rules 2022 (Form ODI via AD bank + annual APR, with penalties for lateness). Do that with a CA.
details: ODI/FEMA details are from secondary sources; verify with a CA/lawyer. Delaware raised its incorporation fee to USD 109 from 1 Aug 2026 (single secondary source).

verify.note: Stripe Atlas page confirms USD 500 incl. state fees and first-year agent, USD 100/yr after, and the USD 500 back on a USD 5k Treasury deposit. AWS India-seller restriction confirmed on the AWS FAQ. The FEMA APR due date of 31 Dec is confirmed in FEMA 400/2022-RB Reg 10(4). Delaware's site links a fee schedule PDF named 'AugustFee2026', which corroborates an Aug 2026 fee change; amount not read.
